addOns.name: Extra credits (1,000 per $5 on Hobby, cheaper per-credit rate on higher tiers)

cautions.en: Costs scale by API operation: scrape/crawl/map cost 1 credit/page, search costs 2 credits per 10 results, browser 'interact' costs 2 credits/minute, and monitoring costs 1 credit per page per check; actual spend depends heavily on usage pattern, not just the plan's monthly credit allowance.

capabilities.en: Converts any website into clean, structured data (Markdown/JSON) via a scraping and crawling API.
Offers a search API and a site-mapping capability alongside scraping, plus browser-based 'interact' actions for dynamic pages.
Provides a monitoring feature to re-check pages for changes on a schedule.

limitations.en: Usage is credit-metered; scraping large sites or using search/interact features can consume the monthly allowance quickly.
Concurrency (parallel requests) is capped per plan (2 on Free up to 100 on Scale), which limits large-batch crawling speed on lower tiers.

reason.en: Direct competitor offering web scraping/crawling APIs for structured data extraction.
Competing browser-automation/scraping API used for similar structured web data extraction workflows.
